articles.title: God of War Laufey is coming to the PS5
articles.summary: At its State of Play showcase event at Summer Game Fest, Sony showed off the next God of War game for the PS5.
articles.body: Sony ended its big State of Play showcase with a major reveal: the next God of War. The new title is called God of War Laufey, and is once again developed by Sony’s Santa Monica Studio. Currently, the game doesn’t have a date, but it’s coming to the PS5 whenever it does launch. This time, instead of perpetually furious dad Kratos, players will take control of Faye / Laufey, as the title implies. That means that while the tone of the game seems somewhat similar to past God of War titles, the gameplay looks quite different, with much more aerobatic action punctuated by magic instead of Kratos’ heavy violence. Also, there’s a giant, six-legged cat that can fly. And a talking gelatinous cube named Phranque that fights alongside you. You can get a good look at the game in action with this lengthy 20-minute reveal video: [Media: Deborah Ann Woll, who played Faye in God of War Ragnarök, is reprising the role for Laufey. The game’s cast also includes Jack Quaid as Phranque and Perlina Lau as Rue, the talking ribbons attached Faye’s sword. [Media: Ever since a soft reboot in 2018, God of War has become one of Sony’s tentpole series, on par with the likes of The Last of Us and the Horizon games. A sequel, Ragnarök, launched on the PS5 in 2022, and the series is also being turned into a live-action streaming show on Prime Video. Earlier this year Sony surprise-launched a 2D prequel called Sons of Sparta. The new game is a shift for blockbuster video games, which for years have focused on stories about dads. With Faye’s starring role, it seems like moms are finally getting their due.

articles.title: Tish Cyrus Calls Daughter Miley’s Wedding to Maxx Morando the ‘Most Magical Night’
articles.summary: The “Wrecking Ball” singer tied the knot with drummer Maxx Morando in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 21
articles.body:
Miley Cyrus' mom, Tish Cyrus, said her daughter's wedding was "the most magical night" in an Instagram post

Miley married drummer Maxx Morando in a romantic poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 21, after five years of dating

Tish attended the nuptials with her husband, actor Dominic Purcell, whom she married in 2023, while Miley's dad, Billy Ray Cyrus, and his girlfriend Elizabeth Hurley were also present

Miley Cyrus ' mom, Tish Cyrus , is looking back on her daughter's special day!

Miley, 34, married Lilly drummer Maxx Morando , 28, in a romantic poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 21, after five years of dating, and Tish, 59, and her actor husband Dominic Purcell , 56, were among those in attendance.

Tish, who is also Miley's manager, shared a photo of herself at the nuptials in a black gown, hand-in-hand with her husband, on Instagram . "Walking into the most magical night 🤍," she wrote, before making a sweet nod to her daughter and new son-in-law's initials and the date of their big day: "M+M 11-21-26."

She added another photo of herself and Purcell, who sported a black suit. "Soooo good," Purcell's daughter Lily-Rose commented alongside a heart-eyed emoji.

Purcell also shared the second snap from his wife's carousel on Instagram and simply wrote, "Tish," next to a red heart emoji.

Miley's dad Billy Ray Cyrus, 65, and his girlfriend Elizabeth Hurley , 61, were also in attendance at the wedding , as were her sisters, Noah Cyrus and Brandi Cyrus , and Hurley's son Damian , 24.

"The most special part was seeing Miley's family all come together to celebrate her," a source told PEOPLE about the occasion , which came after years of ups and downs for the family.

"They wanted her to feel loved and for her to have a magical wedding day," the source said. "Knowing how much it took to get to that point, seeing them all together was really moving."

Billy Ray and Tish were married for almost three decades and had five children together before Tish filed for divorce in 2022. He adopted her older two children, daughter Brandi , 39, and son Trace , 37, before they welcomed Miley, son Braison , 32, and Noah, 26. Billy Ray also has another son, Christopher, 34, with ex-girlfriend Kristin Luckey.

Tish began dating Purcell in November 2022, months after she filed for divorce. They confirmed their engagement in April 2023, and married in Malibu, Calif. , in August that year. Miley was there to walk her mom down the aisle in a tender moment, too.

"My whole life my mom has been behind the scenes," Miley told Vogue after her mom's wedding. "She was always the one getting me ready for big days, starting with cheerleading competitions, then eventually on sets or backstage before a performance."

"She has never stopped celebrating me and has been so supportive of my decisions," the "Wrecking Ball" singer continued. "I feel honored to be that person for her, now that I'm older."

articles.title: Shabana Azmi on burqa debate: 'If someone tells me I can't wear a burqa, I'll wear three of them'; also defends women's freedom to choose what they wear
articles.summary: Veteran actor Shabana Azmi has spoken openly about how religious teachings are understood and the ongoing debate over women wearing the burqa.
articles.body: Veteran actor Shabana Azmi has spoken openly about how religious teachings are understood and the ongoing debate over women wearing the burqa. In a recent podcast, she said the Quran does not specifically direct women to wear one and stressed that personal choice must be respected.What Shabana Azmi said about the Quran and burqaTalking to Usha Kakade on her podcast, Shabana Azmi explained that religious texts are often misread or presented wrongly. She said the idea of modesty in the Quran applies equally to everyone. "It's nowhere mentioned in the Quran that you should wear a burqa like this. It's just written in the Quran that there should be modesty in your eyes. That modesty is for both women and men," she said.Defending personal freedom of choiceShabana Azmi made it clear that her stand is also about an individual's right to decide for herself. She does not wear a burqa but would resist anyone who tries to force her not to.Shabana Azmi asserted, "I don't wear a burqa, but I also believe that if someone tells me I can't wear a burqa, I'll wear three of them. Who are you to tell me that? But it can't happen that under the veil of secularism, you spread fundamentalism."Her views on faith and husband Javed AkhtarIn an earlier conversation on IIMUN's YouTube channel, the actor shared a light-hearted anecdote about her own language habits and how they lead to banter at home.She said, "Like sometimes, I say 'mashallah' and 'inshallah', but Javed says, 'Why do you keep saying this? What if someone says 'prabhu ji ki marzi' all the time, how will you feel?' But I feel it's just something that's a part of my language."She added that religion has never really interested her, while her husband, veteran lyricist Javed Akhtar, is a firm atheist.She said, "He is a very staunch atheist. I am saying, 'Why do you have to wear this on your sleeve? If there is somebody who is getting some solace out of practising religion, let it be. Why offend them?' He says, 'Because they offend me. Don't I have a right as an atheist to be offended by that?'"Faith is a private matter, says Shabana AzmiDescribing her own relationship with religion, Shabana Azmi said she enjoys the cultural side of her identity but does not follow rituals."Yes, I am a Muslim, and I like Eid, Urdu, the food, I like all of that. But we don't read namaz, and we have no association with religion as such. The concept of God... It isn't anything that I have had to deal with, except that I feel that it's really a private matter. The state shouldn't get involved. It's a private matter, and if you feel good after praying, then I don't have any problem with it at all," added Shabana Azmi.On the work front, the actress was last seen in 'Awarapan 2' and 'Batwara 1947'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' final trailer out: Robert Downey Jr's Doctor Doom targets Steve Rogers' family, Fantastic Four launch rescue mission, X-Men cross over into main MCU timeline as multiversal Incursions threaten Earth
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', which arrives in theatres on December 18.
articles.body: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', which arrives in theatres on December 18. The footage promises large-scale multiverse action and marks Robert Downey Jr's comeback to the MCU as Doctor Doom, an alternate-universe version of Tony Stark.Doctor Doom targets the Steve Rogers familyThe trailer shows Steve Rogers leading a peaceful life with Peggy Carter while hiding his past as a superhero from their son. That calm breaks when Doctor Doom, pushed by the loss of everything he valued, goes after the family. The Fantastic Four then step in to save Steve.Incursions threaten the multiverseThough Doom is the main villain, the bigger danger comes from incursions. In these catastrophic events, two universes crash into each other, and either one is sacrificed so the other survives, or both are wiped out.Heroes of Earth-616 and Earth-828 are facing this threat for the first time. The seasoned X-Men are the ones who must get them ready before Doom reveals his true plan.Cast and crossoverThe film brings together characters from across the MCU, along with several heroes from Fox's X-Men films, who formally join the main timeline. Along with Downey Jr, the cast includes:Chris Evans as Steve Rogers/Captain America, Chris Hemsworth as Thor, Paul Rudd as Ant-Man, Letitia Wright as Black Panther, Sebastian Stan as the Winter Soldier, Tom Hiddleston as Loki, and Simu Liu as Shang-Chi.Strong box office run ahead of releaseThe trailer lands as the franchise enjoys good momentum. The re-release 'Avengers: Endgame Encore', which has four new scenes linked to 'Doomsday', opened at No. 1 at the domestic box office with USD 26 million. articles.title: Sergio Peris-Mencheta reaparece desde La Paz después de un nuevo ingreso hospitalario: "Progresando adecuadamente"
articles.standfirst: El actor, que lucha contra las secuelas de la leucemia y del trasplante de médula ósea al que se sometió en 2024, agradece los cuidados y asegura que pronto volverá a casa y a los ensayos teatrales
articles.summary: El actor, que lucha contra las secuelas de la leucemia y del trasplante de médula ósea al que se sometió en 2024, agradece los cuidados y asegura que pronto volverá a casa y a los ensayos teatrales
articles.body: El actor Sergio Peris-Mencheta ha reaparecido en redes sociales después de tener que ser ingresado en el Hospital Universitario La Paz de Madrid el pasado viernes. El actor, que desde principios de 2024 atraviesa un largo proceso de recuperación tras ser diagnosticado de leucemia, ha compartido un vídeo desde el centro hospitalario para tranquilizar a sus seguidores y agradecer las muestras de cariño recibidas. "Progresando adecuadamente", ha escrito junto a la grabación, en la que transmite un mensaje de optimismo y confianza en su recuperación. "Gracias por vuestros mensajes. Gracias a los equipos de enfermeros y médicos de La Paz por el cuidado y los cuidados. Gracias a la Sanidad Pública. Y gracias una vez más a Antonio. Pronto en casa de vuelta. Pronto en los ensayos de vuelta", ha publicado Sergio Peris-Mencheta. Un mensaje con el que ha querido agradecer tanto la atención recibida por parte del personal sanitario como el apoyo de las personas que le acompañan durante su recuperación. El intérprete no ha detallado las causas concretas de este nuevo ingreso, al que se ha referido como una "buena avería". La enfermedad de Sergio Peris-Mencheta salió a la luz a principios de 2024, cuando el propio actor comunicó a través de sus redes sociales que padecía leucemia. Desde entonces, ha afrontado un largo y complicado tratamiento que incluyó un trasplante de médula ósea en el que su hermano fue el donante, después de comprobarse que ambos tenían una compatibilidad completa. Sin embargo, el procedimiento le provocó importantes complicaciones. Entre ellas, la enfermedad del injerto contra huésped, una reacción que se produce cuando las células del donante reconocen el organismo del receptor como extraño y lo atacan, pudiendo afectar a distintos órganos y tejidos. Esta complicación, junto a los efectos de la quimioterapia y la radioterapia, le dejó importantes secuelas físicas. El actor sufrió un notable oscurecimiento de la piel, perdió hasta 25 kilos y tuvo que hacer frente a problemas de memoria y a una fuerte hinchazón. Una experiencia que recogió en su libro '730 días', en el que relató los dos años de lucha contra la enfermedad y las dificultades de un proceso que también ha estado marcado por el apoyo constante de su mujer, Marta Solaz, sus hijos y el resto de su familia. Tal y como explicó su esposa en una entrevista concedida a la revista Lecturas, la pareja regresó a España después de que el actor recibiera tratamiento en el centro médico City of Hope, en Estados Unidos, para continuar aquí con su recuperación. Sergio Peris-Mencheta está siendo atendido ahora por la sanidad pública española, y su agradecimiento al personal sanitario del Hospital La Paz ha sido uno de los aspectos destacados de su última publicación. En la citada entrevista, Marta Solaz también habló de cómo ha vivido la enfermedad de su marido durante estos casi tres años. "Pues lo he vivido como si fuera algo de los dos. No lo he sentido algo separado de mí. Lo he sentido que era una cosa de los dos. Entonces, desde el minuto cero he estado ahí dedicada", explicó. La actriz reconoció que ha sido especialmente complicado compaginar las exigencias del tratamiento con el cuidado de sus hijos y el resto de responsabilidades familiares. "Te encuentras con que todo sucede a la vez. He sido un poco el centro de todo lo que iba sucediendo. Porque los niños estaban pendientes de mí. Y yo estaba pendiente de ellos", relató, agradeciendo también la ayuda recibida por parte de su madre, su hermana y otros familiares. Marta Solaz destacó, además, la importancia de mantener una actitud práctica y positiva ante un proceso tan largo y exigente. "Cuando lo vives te pones en modo supervivencia. Además, es un proceso muy largo que dura un año entero. Lo que sería el trasplante y todo. Es un proceso lento, así que o te pones en una mente práctica, resolutiva y positiva o es difícil de sostener", aseguró. Mientras continúa con su recuperación, Sergio Peris-Mencheta mantiene la esperanza de regresar pronto a casa y retomar los ensayos teatrales, una señal de optimismo en una lucha contra la enfermedad que sigue marcando su vida.

articles.title: Steven Spielberg Sets Adaptation Of ‘The Heart In Winter’ As Next Film At Focus With Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy And Mark Rylance Starring And Paul Thomas Anderson Adapting The Script
articles.summary: EXCLUSIVE: For years, Steven Spielberg has talked about how much he’s wanted to direct a Western and it now looks like the three-time Oscar winner has found...
articles.body:
EXCLUSIVE: For years, Steven Spielberg has talked about how much he's wanted to direct a Western and it now looks like the three-time Oscar winner has found the perfect project to saddle up for. Sources tell Deadline, Spielberg is developing an untitled film for Focus Features and has assembled an all-star roster of A-list talent to bring it together. Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy and Mark Rylance are set to star in the film, directed by Spielberg from a script by Oscar winner Paul Thomas Anderson, based on Kevin Barry's The Heart in Winter .

The film will come out some time in 2028 and follows two star-crossed fugitives trying to find a place for themselves in the American West. Kristie Macosko Krieger, Sara Murphy, Anderson and Spielberg will produce the film. Tim Headington, Neil Shah, Ryan Zacarias, and Ana Leocha will executive produce.

Spielberg spoke with Deadline about his decision to make this his first Western, and said not only did the story speak to him, but the opportunity to work with his longtime friend Anderson was too good to pass up.

"It's really the excitement for me to get to work together with my dear friend and colleague Paul Thomas Anderson on a genre, but more particularly, the genre notwithstanding, a story that quite quickly became close to both our hearts and we felt that we could do as a team."

This will mark the first time Anderson has written something without directing it too, which just shows how much the Oscar-winning director wanted to work with Spielberg. Though many view Anderson more for his directing then writing, he is coming off an Oscar win for best adapted screenplay for One Battle After Another, a novel many believed was too tough of a story to adapt.

Spielberg said the two had begun talking about potentially working together since January and while they hadn't on this book since then, they very much wanted to make something set in America in the late 1800s.

"We've sat in screening rooms, and by the way, only on 35mm film, and watched dozens of Westerns," Spielberg added.

As for the casting process, Spielberg said they were his top choices, and frankly Buckley and Murphy were "the only two actors that could play these characters."

"This story is about the people who refused to settle for a life that is less then they deserve but maybe more than they can handle," Spielberg said. "Jessie and Cillian were the first people to ever come to mind for this and they also have never made a film together."

Spielberg was also super excited at the idea of making the film at Focus Features after working with the studio on Hamnet, which he produced, and would land Buckley an Oscar for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars.

"I'm really excited to be working with Kujo at Focus after doing Hamnet together, so it's a reunion in a sense for Jessie and it's also a reunion for PTA who did Phantom Thread at Focus Features," Spielberg said. "It's going to be a real hybrid production with Universal handling production, who will release through the Focus label, and both teams are going to work very closely with each other, which I'm very excited for as I know both worlds at Universal intimately."

Spielberg has a longstanding relationship with Universal Pictures and Focus Features. Most recently, Spielberg released Disclosure Day with Universal Pictures, which opened at No. 1 at the box office to critical acclaim. Spielberg also recently produced Hamnet for Focus Features, which received eight Oscar nominations, with Buckley winning Best Actress.

Spielberg added that his selections for below the line are still in process, but the plan is to shoot next year in the winter.

As for the question of whether this film was also a metaphor for his directing riding off into the sunset and making it his last film, not only is it not, but the iconic director has an idea of how he would want to do that when that day comes.

"If I wanted to ride off into the sunset, I would have done Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade next and I could have had those characters literally riding off into the sunset as the credits roll," Spielberg said.

Besides Hamnet, Buckley can be seen next in Three Incestuous Sisters, which also stars Saoirse Ronan, Dakota Johnson and Josh O'Connor. Murphy can be seen next in the new prison drama from Damien Chazelle that also stars Daniel Craig and Michelle Williams.

Buckley is represented by CAA, United Agents and Johnson Shapiro Slewett & Kole. Murphy is represented by WME and Sloane Offer Weber & Dern. Rylance is represented by CAA and Peikoff Mahan Law Office. Anderson is represented by CAA and Jackoway Austen Tyerman Wertheimer Mandelbaum Morris Bernstein Trattner Auerbach Hynick Jaime LeVine Sample & Klein

articles.title: Brad Pitt Unexpectedly Drops Out of Public Appearance After Falling Ill (Report)
articles.summary: The actor was expected to attend the London premiere of his new movie, ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’
articles.body:
Brad Pitt canceled his London premiere appearance for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth due to the flu, according to a statement provided to The Independent

Director David Fincher and costars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan and others will still attend the event

Pitt reprises his Oscar-winning role as Cliff Booth in the film, which premieres in IMAX on Nov. 25

Brad Pitt has unexpectedly pulled out of a red carpet appearance for his new movie, The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth .

The actor, 62, was set to appear alongside director David Fincher and costar Elizabeth Debicki at the London premiere of the film on Monday, Nov. 23, but dropped out at the last minute after falling ill with the flu, per The Independent .

Pitt "is no longer able to attend the premiere as he has come down with flu and has been advised not to travel," organizers for the event said in a statement obtained by the U.K. outlet.

A rep for Pitt has not yet responded to PEOPLE's request for comment.

Fincher, 64, and Debicki, 36, will still walk the carpet alongside Scott Caan , Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller.

Pitt last appeared publicly at the Nov. 16 premiere of the Fincher-directed movie in Los Angeles, where he was joined by his girlfriend of four years, Ines de Ramon . The two held hands while walking the red carpet, posing for photos.

Pitt is reprising his Oscar-winning role as the charismatic stuntman Cliff Booth in the new movie, written by Quentin Tarantino . The film comes seven years after he first introduced the character in 2019's Once Upon a Time...in Hollywood , which was written and directed by Tarantino, 63.

The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth follows the titular lead eight years after his hijinks with actor Rick Dalton ( Leonardo DiCaprio ) have ended and finds Cliff working multiple jobs, from a projectionist at his local cinema to a bartender. On the side, he's also somewhat of a fixer, being paid to take care of Hollywood's elite's problems in not-so-legal ways.

When a famous actor asks him to handle a particularly sticky situation, Cliff may finally be in over his head.

Pitt won the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for his first run as the character at the 2020 Academy Awards. Fincher previously told Empire magazine that the actor remains the leading expert on Cliff .

"The weirdest, most interesting part of this, for me, is that I've never been in a situation where the person playing the character knows more about that character than you'll ever know," he said. "Sometimes you have to push back on that. I knew the new stuff, and Brad knew who the guy was, so Brad could withstand the hurricane of, 'What about this? What about that?' He was like, 'No, no, no. I got this.' "

The movie marks Pitt and Fincher's fourth collaboration together following 1995's Se7en , 1999's Fight Club and 2008's The Curious Case of Benjamin Button . In fact, it was Pitt who first approached Fincher with the project after Tarantino passed on directing it.

"We have a mutual friend who was disappointed that he wasn't going to play Cliff Booth again and he said, 'Do you want to read this [script]?' I said, 'I would love to.' He said, 'But do you want to read it?,' " Fincher said.

"And I said, 'I wouldn't do that unless you have permission,'" he added. "And [Pitt] came back and said, 'I have permission!' And I said, 'Okay, I will read it.' And I was smitten."

The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is in theaters for two weeks exclusively in IMAX beginning Nov. 25. The movie begins streaming on Netflix Dec. 23.

articles.title: Silvia Intxaurrondo anuncia que recurrirá la sanción de la Junta Electoral Central en los tribunales: "Ataque a la libertad de prensa"
articles.standfirst: La comunicadora destaca que la propia Junta admite el pluralismo mostrado en su tertulia televisiva
articles.summary: La comunicadora destaca que la propia Junta admite el pluralismo mostrado en su tertulia televisiva
articles.body: La periodista Silvia Intxaurrondo ha anunciado su intención de acudir a la Justicia para recurrir el expediente sancionador que le ha abierto la Junta Electoral Central (JEC). A través de su perfil oficial en la red social X, la comunicadora ha manifestado su profundo rechazo ante una resolución que considera inédita en la historia reciente del periodismo español y que apunta directamente contra su labor profesional. En su publicación, la presentadora de Televisión Española subraya la gravedad de que el organismo arbitral haya decidido actuar de manera individualizada contra una profesional de la información. "Creo que es la primera vez que la Junta Electoral Central abre un expediente sancionador contra una periodista a título personal por hacer preguntas y plantear un debate", señala Intxaurrondo en el arranque de su comunicado público. Para respaldar su postura, la comunicadora reproduce un extracto de la propia resolución del organismo, poniendo de relieve la contradicción que, a su juicio, encierra el texto oficial. Según cita, la JEC admite que los hechos tuvieron lugar fuera del tramo de noticias puras, concretamente "en el espacio de análisis y tertulia de La Hora de La 1, y no en su bloque estrictamente informativo". Asimismo, el fragmento difundido recoge el reconocimiento expreso del árbitro electoral sobre el desarrollo plural del programa que conduce. En el escrito se detalla textualmente: "Es cierto que la presentadora formuló sus intervenciones en forma de preguntas y reflexiones y permitió a los colaboradores expresar posiciones discrepantes, incluidas aquellas que defendían la presencia en la televisión pública de todas las formaciones políticas legalmente constituidas". Lejos de amedrentarse ante la apertura del proceso, Intxaurrondo ha adoptado una actitud firme en defensa de su ejercicio profesional en la radiotelevisión pública. La periodista ha dejado claro que asume las consecuencias de su trabajo sin arrepentimiento alguno, asegurando que la decisión administrativa no frena su compromiso con el debate abierto en el espacio matinal. El mensaje concluye con un anuncio contundente sobre los próximos pasos legales que emprenderá para frenar lo que entiende como una injerencia inaceptable en el oficio informativo. "Recibo esta sanción con orgullo. Iremos a los tribunales para revertir este ataque a la libertad de prensa", sentencia la presentadora, elevando el conflicto al ámbito judicial.

articles.title: Billy Bob Thornton says he’s a holiday ‘purist’ as he brings back ‘traditional’ Thanksgiving at home
articles.summary: Billy Bob Thornton says one restaurant Thanksgiving was enough, as his family returns to traditional cooking, football and holiday rituals at home.
articles.body: Billy Bob Thornton tried to have Thanksgiving dinner at a restaurant in the past, and he'll never do it again. During an interview with Fox News Digital about his new Fox Nation series, "The Mayflower," Thornton opened up about his own Thanksgiving traditions and how his newest gig shows the actual events that unfolded in 1621, not what is taught in schools. "Well, I've always been a little bit of a purist in terms of holidays and, especially when you have kids, you want to kind of, you know, keep that tradition going. So my early thanksgivings were in Arkansas, and then after high school I moved to Texas and Houston," he began. "I've always wanted traditional holidays and particularly Thanksgiving and Christmas. And we have that, my family and I always have a traditional Christmas and Thanksgiving." He continued, "But for Thanksgiving, a couple of times over the last decade, we went to a restaurant, and it just didn't seem right." BILLY BOB THORNTON PUSHES BACK ON CELEBRITY ACTIVISM: ‘I DON'T KNOW ANYTHING ABOUT POLITICS’ Thornton said his wife and sister-in-law were tired of the mess that Thanksgiving creates in the kitchen, so they proposed the idea that they go out for dinner instead. "We get there, and it was just like, we do this all the time, what's special about it, you know? And so this year, we're going back to the traditional thing and there's going to be a lot of cooking going on and a lot of football-watching," Thornton said. Thornton hosts and narrates "The Mayflower," which is a three-part historical docudrama. It premieres Monday, Nov. 23, on FOX Nation. By the end of the first winter, half of those people were gone. I mean, that was surprising," he said. Thornton explained that the Fox Nation series created a replica of the ship, which was much smaller than he expected. "We did stuff on the replica of the Mayflower. "And it was all just like, 'Oh, look, look at the Native people. Let's invite them over for dinner, you know, and make peace.' And it wasn't like that. I mean, there was a war involved in this." "To be a part of something like this, to actually host something that educates you – and believe me, it educated me. I learned as I went along – I did not know this story. And so I just love being a part and telling a story that people don't know about," he said. articles.title: New magical shows worth watching instead of Harry Potter
articles.summary: From Percy Jackson and the Olympians to Bass X Machina, there are plenty of excellent fantasy series to stream this holiday season.
articles.body: Since we wrote earlier this year about J.K. Rowling using her money to support groups and policies harming transgender people, she has accused the United Nations of promoting “sex denialism” and described trans rights activists as “elitists” whose work creates “a climate of fear and intimidation.” Also, her upcoming HBO Harry Potter series has not looked particularly good in any of the clips that have been released so far. This take on Rowling’s novels appears to be a visually uninspired rehash of Warner Bros.’ film adaptations that’s designed for people who can’t free themselves from the shackles of nostalgia. But this year, there have been plenty of other new and returning shows that are filled with the kind of magic and mystery that gets fantasies going. And with the holiday season coming up, it’s the perfect time to give some of these less-problematic series a watch. Percy Jackson and the Olympians [Media: The second season of Disney’s adaptation of Rick Riordan’s fantasy series picks up at a time when all Percy Jackson (Walker Scobell) wants it to get back to Camp Half-Blood and reunite with his best friends Annabeth (Leah Sava Jeffries) and Grover (Aryan Simhadri). But when Percy arrives at the camp, Annabeth acts like she wants nothing to do with him, and Grover has gone missing under mysterious circumstances. The peril Grover seems to be in prompts Percy to embark on an adventure to the Sea of Monsters to save him. It’s the kind of quest that turns demigods into legendary heroes, but it’s one that pushes Percy to his limits. Compared to last season, this chapter of Percy Jackson and the Olympians appears to be more epic in scale as it fleshes out its world of Greek gods and monsters. And now that the new season is airing, it’s a must-watch for fans of Riordan’s novels. Coven Academy [Media: When Briar Roberts (Malina Weissman) first arrives at Crescent Veil Academy in New Orleans, she assumes that the place is just a ramshackle school for delinquent teenagers. Briar thinks she’s been shipped off to Crescent Veil because of her anger issues and run-ins with the police. But headmistress Emma Graves (Tiffani Thiessen) and the other students quickly make it clear that they — like Briar — are powerful witches whose magic makes them targets for evil monsters. Coven Academy’s a pretty classic coming-of-age story that feels like a cross between American Horror Story: Coven and Degrassi: The Next Generation. It’s cheesy, but it’s an easy watch if you’re looking for something lighthearted on Disney Plus. Witch Hat Atelier [Media: Adapted from Kamome Shirahama’s manga series, Witch Hat Atelier tells the story of Coco (Anjali Kunapaneni) — a young girl who dreams of becoming a witch even though she doesn’t seem to have any innate mystical abilities. In the land of the Zozah Peninsula, only a select group of people are allowed by the Great Hall of Witches to practice any sort of magic. But when Coco accidentally casts a powerful spell by reading from a book, the witch Qifrey (Joshua A. Waters) takes her in as his latest apprentice. Witch Hat Atelier is one of the most gorgeous fantasy anime to hit Crunchyroll in 2026. Even if witchcraft isn’t really your thing, it’s a tremendous show that’s worth a watch. VisionQuest [Media: As a synthezoid powered by genuine artificial intelligence, Vision (Paul Bettany) prefers to think of himself as a man of logic and reason. The former Avenger understands he is a machine built by a team of engineers, but on some level, he also knows that the Scarlet Witch’s magic played a role in his becoming the newest version of himself. Even with that knowledge, Vision has a difficult time processing his feelings when he crosses paths with Thomas Shepherd (Ruaridh Mollica), a Scottish orphan who seems to have a spiritual connection to the robotic hero. And to make things worse, Vision has to deal with his homicidal father, Ultron (James Spader), trying to make him relive traumatic memories. Following Agatha All Along, VisionQuest cements the WandaVision trilogy as one of the most riveting stories Marvel has produced to date. The series is brilliant on its own, and it portends some very promising things for the MCU’s future. Bass X Machina [Media: Set in an alternate, steampunk past where people are trying to settle the Wild West with the help of autonomous machines, Netflix’s Bass X Machina follows bounty hunter Bass Reeves (Brian Tyree Henry) as he finishes his last gig before retiring. Reeves is trying to leave the gunslinging life behind him in order to spend time with his family, but with money being tight, he can’t afford to give his robotic shooting arm a rest just yet. If Reeves had his way, he would just bag a couple of ordinary outlaws, collect their bounties, and be on his way. But fate has other plans, and Reeves winds up journeying into Choctaw Country on a mission to investigate a local man’s mysterious disappearance. Though Bass X Machina initially seems to be a straightforward steampunk anime, it takes a surprisingly magical turn that infuses its story with intrigue. And the show’s visuals are stunning — which isn’t a surprise given that it’s produced by Studio Mir. Carrie [Media: Mike Flanagan’s adaptation of Stephen King’s seminal novel for Amazon isn’t exactly fantasy, but it does present Carrie White (Summer H. Howell) as part of a group of women who have been historically persecuted for having talents that seem otherworldly. When Carrie comes across a book about women accused of being witches, she can’t help but see herself in their stories and she wonders if she, too, might be burned at the stake if people learn her secret. Though this spin on Carrie stays fairly faithful to the novel, Flanagan modernizes the story in order to tackle the realities of how kids bully one another in the age of social media. And while the show definitely takes some creative liberties that might confound King’s fans, it features one of the most terrifying (in a good way) depictions of Carrie’s fateful prom. Small Prophets [Media: Though Michael Sleep’s (Pearce Quigley) nosy neighbors know that he’s up to something strange in his shed, they have no idea that he’s experimenting with a recipe to grow prophetic homunculi in jars. According to a book of alchemy owned by Sleep’s father, Brian (Michael Palin), properly raised homunculi have the supernatural ability to accurately answer any question they’re asked. Sleep isn’t entirely convinced that what he’s doing will work, but he toils away in hopes that the humanoid creatures will be able to help him locate his long-lost girlfriend. As much as Small Prophets is a comedy, it’s also a touching drama about grief and the challenges of building new friendships as people enter the latter stages of their lives. Like many British series, Apple TV’s Small Prophets is a pretty quick watch, and it has already been renewed for a second season. The Vampire Lestat [Media: In its third season, AMC’s Interview With the Vampire gets a rebrand that mirrors the way Lestat de Lioncourt (Sam Reid) reinvents himself as the front man of a rock band. Lestat’s music career gives him a way to continue thumbing his nose at vampires’ laws about secrecy and to take his mind off his former lover, Louis de Pointe du Lac (Jacob Anderson). Try as they might, it’s hard for Lestat and Louis to stay away from one another, even though it strains their romantic entanglements with others. And the closer the two get to reconciling their relationship, the more innocent people around them get gravely hurt. Though this series has always been phenomenal, The Vampire Lestat reaches new emotional heights that make you feel how much these characters have evolved over time. And this season sets the stage for yet another surprising pivot into one of Anne Rice’s best stories. American Horror Story: 13 [Media: Rather than committing to a completely new story the way previous chapters have, American Horror Story: 13 brings back a number of characters from past seasons. Almost every single cast member reprises multiple roles, and the show spins a wild tale that occasionally feels like a return to the series’ glory days — particularly when it’s focused on Supreme witches Cordelia Goode (Sarah Paulson) and her mother, Fiona (Jessica Lange). Though all of the witches can sense that a powerful evil is rising, they don’t know that Constance Langdon (also Lange) plays a pivotal role in the strange happenings across the world. Constance herself doesn’t fully understand what her new boss Mr. Nas (Paul Anthony Kelly and Fedor Steer) is trying to accomplish, but she follows his orders because she has faith that their desires are aligned. American Horror Story: 13 is at its best when it leans hard into camp and lets its ensemble cut loose as they move through the season’s ridiculous twists. And while it’s nowhere near as good as American Horror Story: Coven, it’s just great to see Lange hamming it up on the small screen again. The Witch Farm [Media: Inspired by real-world events, the BBC’s four-part series The Witch Farm tells the story of an English family who move to a remote house in the Welsh wilderness for a fresh start. At first, Liz (Gabrielle Creevy), her husband Bill (Michael Socha), and their son Jonathan (Lewin Lloyd) love their rustic new home, but it isn’t long before they begin to suspect that a malevolent presence is lurking in the shadows. While Liz and Bill don’t believe in ghosts, they can’t ignore the way people in their small town speak about their house as a place of evil. And as the couple learns more about the house’s history, they start to realize that they might have really wandered into a nightmare. The Witch Farm is only available to stream on BBC iPlayer, and it looks like a solid spooky treat for folks who love haunting horror.

articles.title: Apple renews Ted Lasso for season 5
articles.summary: Apple has announced that it has renewed Ted Lasso for season 5 on Apple TV.
articles.body: One of Apple’s biggest shows is sticking around for at least one more season. The streamer announced today that Ted Lasso has been renewed for a fifth season on Apple TV, after what the company calls a “record-breaking season four debut.” There are currently no details about the new season nor when it might debut. Ted Lasso has proven to be one of the tentpole series for Apple TV, and it returned in 2026 after a three-year hiatus. While the season 3 finale seemed to mark the end for the show, season 4 introduced a new cast of characters with head coach Ted — played by Jason Sudeikis, who also just appeared as a voice actor in Grand Theft Auto VI — managing a new professional women’s team. The news comes amidst a handful of other recent renewals from Apple — including a second season of Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed and multiple new seasons of Slow Horses — in what is turning out to be a strong year for the streaming service, as it attempts to reach a larger audience.

articles.title: Thinly veiled Vanity Fair piece appears to paint Taylor Swift as vindictive
articles.summary: A magazine article about an unnamed “mastermind” appears to describe Taylor Swift as a pop star with a mean streak. The Vanity Fair story in question begins...
articles.body:
A magazine article about an unnamed "mastermind" appears to describe Taylor Swift as a pop star with a mean streak.

The Vanity Fair story in question begins by describing "a generational talent" born in Reading, Pa., in 1989 who signs with a record label in Nashville.

"Her name foretells her future fate: the Latin root of celebrity is celere, meaning "rapid," "fast," "swift," the article seemingly hints. It further notes that the subject is recently married, using the phrase "your English and your gym teachers wed."

That's how Swift announced her engagement to NFL star Travis Kelce on social media.

What follows is a critical essay based on conversations with more than 100 people linked to the story's subject. One music executive refers to her as "punitive."

Several people Vanity Fair contacted refused to speak about "The Star" without permission or asked that their conversations be kept confidential. The implication is that they fear retribution.

"If you don't see it her way, she comes after you," an acquaintance of the shrewd operator said.

Chanice Skinner, who went to school with the unidentified celebrity, described her as a privileged snob who's reinvented herself as an underdog.

"If anything, you were one of the bullies," Skinner said.

The Vanity Fair's story alleges "The Star" is largely viewed as a "combination of victim and victimizer."

It also paints its subject as being generous to fellow musicians who hitch their rising stars to her rocket-fueled superstardom. Many of those people are said to remain in her orbit.

As if the allusions to Swift weren't clear enough, Vanity Fair's piece details an incident in which masses of people gathered at Madison Square Garden, where she Swift and Kelce married in July.

Not everyone was looking to commit a hard foul on Swift Monday. Knicks guard Jalen Brunson told US Weekly that he considers the "Bad Blood" singer a true fan weeks after his teammate Tyler Kolek questioned her sincerity when she's sitting courtside at the Garden cheering on the championship winning team.

"I can't believe I have to say this," Brunson told US Weekly. "Yes, she's a member of the Knicks fandom. Yes, she is."

Swift's representatives haven't responded to a request for comment nor did the subject of the Vanity Fair article respond to inquiries.
authors: Brian Niemietz, New York Daily News

articles.title: Brilha Natal 2026: Confira a programação de shows gratuitos em Natal | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento acontece de 1º a 31 de dezembro, com atividades no Alecrim, Cidade Alta e Praça Cívica. Diogo Nogueira é a principal atração do Festival Gastronômico e Cultural, no dia 11.
articles.summary: O Brilha Natal 2026 promove shows gratuitos de Diogo Nogueira, festivais e ações no comércio do Alecrim e Cidade Alta durante todo o mês de dezembro em Natal.
articles.body:
Diogo Nogueira é uma das atrações do Brilha Natal 2026 — Foto: Divulgação

A quarta edição do projeto Brilha Natal foi apresentada na segunda-feira (23) pelo Sistema Fecomércio RN, Sesc e Senac e contará com show gratuito de Diogo Nogueira, apresentações artísticas, oficinas, campanha promocional e atividades no comércio de rua. As atividades acontecerão em diferentes pontos da cidade durante o mês de dezembro.

As ações acontecem de 1º a 31 de dezembro, principalmente nos bairros do Alecrim e da Cidade Alta e na Praça Pedro Velho, conhecida como Praça Cívica. A programação também inclui atividades no Aeroporto de Natal.

Show de Diogo Nogueira e Festival Gastronômico

O Festival Gastronômico e Cultural está marcado para acontecer entre 11 e 13 de dezembro, na Praça Cívica. Na abertura, os finalistas do Festival Sesc de Música e convidados se apresentam a partir das 18h30. Em seguida, o cantor Diogo Nogueira sobe ao palco.

Nos dias 12 e 13, a programação inclui apresentações de balé, circo e música, além de atrações infantis. O espaço também terá a Feira Garajal, encontros com Papai Noel e personagens da literatura infantil.

18h30 – O Circo do Bisteca e Bochechinha

O Senac oferecerá oficinas gastronômicas na Cozinha-Show e serviços gratuitos de saúde e beleza, como massoterapia, penteados, aferição de pressão arterial e teste de glicemia. A Carreta Natalina também funcionará nos três dias do festival, com viagens gratuitas.

O acesso às atividades do festival será gratuito mediante doação de 1 kg de alimento para o programa Sesc Mesa Brasil.

Caminhada Histórica e apresentações no Teatro Sesc

No dia 19 de dezembro, a Caminhada Histórica percorrerá o Centro Histórico de Natal, com intervenções culturais. A atividade será conduzida pelo professor Henrique Lucena, em parceria com instrutores do Sesc e Senac.

O evento também contará com uma exposição de fotografias do projeto Cores Potiguares, do Senac RN.A programação de dezembro inclui ainda quatro apresentações no Teatro Sesc Sandoval Wanderley.

Dias 1º, 3, 8, 10, 15, 17 e 18/12, das 14h às 17h: LABMAIS – Oficina de fotografia com Brunno Martins. Inscrições de 23 a 27/11. Classificação: a partir de 15 anos.

2/12, às 19h: Grupo Carmin – espetáculo A Invenção do Nordeste.

2, 4, 9, 11, 16 e 18/12, das 14h às 17h: Oficina de violão – níveis intermediário, médio e avançado.

5/12, às 19h: Laryssa Costa – Se Eu Quiser Falar com Gil. Acessibilidade em Libras.

10/12, às 19h: Movidos Dança – Ser(tão).

11/12, às 19h: Cia. Era uma Vez – O Natal do Mickey, Minnie, Woody e as Irmãs Frozen.

12/12, às 19h: Grupo Reboliço de Teatro – Anavantu: um passo para frente e dois... (título aparece cortado na imagem).

18/12, às 19h: Show Baile da Tica, com Tiquinha Rodrigues.

Campanha promocional no Alecrim e na Cidade Alta

De 1º a 31 de dezembro, lojas participantes do Alecrim e da Cidade Alta farão parte de uma campanha promocional. Consumidores que comprarem acima de R$ 50 nesses estabelecimentos receberão cupons para concorrer a prêmios.

Durante o período, a Trupe Natalina também fará cerca de 20 intervenções itinerantes nas ruas dos dois bairros, com música e personagens.

A programação começa antes mesmo de dezembro. Entre 27 e 29 de novembro e de 4 a 6 de dezembro, Papai Noel e outros personagens vão receber passageiros e visitantes no Aeroporto de Natal.

A ação será feita em parceria com a Zurich Airport Brasil, administradora do terminal, que também receberá ambientação temática do Brilha Natal.

No dia 21 de janeiro, a Cidade Alta recebe a quarta edição do Sesc Parada na Ladeira, com show de Xanddy Harmonia, apresentações de artistas locais e encontro de bonecos gigantes.

Já no dia 24 de janeiro, o Sesc Zona Norte recebe a segunda edição do Paradinha Kids, com atrações voltadas ao público infantil.

O acesso aos dois eventos será mediante doação de 1 kg de alimento não perecível para o programa Sesc Mesa Brasil.

articles.summary: A festa tomou conta das ruas com a passagem da Carreta da Alegria, enquanto milhares de pessoas participaram da abertura da campanha, que segue até domingo (22).
articles.body:
A abertura do Black Friday 2026 da New Zone Importados movimentou Ciudad del Este, no Paraguai, na noite de quarta-feira (18). A programação contou com a participação da Carreta da Alegria, que percorreu diferentes pontos da cidade com música, dança e personagens característicos. A loja abriu as portas à 00h01 desta quinta-feira (19), com a chegada de milhares de compradores.

A carreta foi um dos destaques da abertura e reuniu moradores, turistas, influenciadores e imprensa durante o percurso pelas ruas da cidade. Com apresentações musicais e coreografias, a atração levou o clima de festa ao centro comercial de Ciudad del Este.

Enquanto a carreta percorria as ruas, milhares de visitantes também chegavam à loja para acompanhar o início da campanha. O movimento continuou durante a madrugada, com compradores circulando pelos diferentes setores e aproveitando as promoções disponíveis.

O Black Friday da New Zone segue até domingo (22), às 21h, com 93 horas de atendimento ininterrupto. Durante o evento, estão disponíveis mais de 6 mil tipos de produtos em promoção, além de ofertas relâmpago com mais de 1.000 itens por dia, em horários especiais ao longo do dia e da madrugada.

“Na New Zone, buscamos oferecer uma experiência que combine compras, entretenimento e comodidade para quem visita Ciudad del Este. Queremos que cada pessoa que passar pela loja durante esses dias possa aproveitar uma proposta diferente” , afirmou Franciele de Souza, diretora de Marketing da empresa.

articles.title: Prefeitura de MT suspende serviços, mas prevê R$ 110 mil para shows | G1
articles.standfirst: Recesso administrativo em Santo Antônio de Leverger (MT) vai de novembro a janeiro; no mesmo Diário Oficial em que foi publicado o decreto, também foram divulgados contratos de três atrações musicais.
articles.summary: Recesso em Santo Antônio de Leverger (MT) segue até janeiro, enquanto prefeitura autoriza R$ 110 mil em cachês para shows de festival gastronômico.
articles.body:
A suspensão começou no dia 19 de novembro e segue até 18 de janeiro de 2027, conforme decreto assinado pela prefeita Francieli Magalhães (PSB) — Foto: Reprodução

A Prefeitura de Santo Antônio de Leverger (MT) suspendeu atividades administrativas por quase dois meses, alegando dificuldades financeiras , mas, no mesmo período, autorizou a contratação de três atrações musicais que somam R$ 110 mil em cachês . Os contratos são de apresentações para o Festival Gastronômico e foram publicados no Diário Oficial desta segunda-feira (23), o mesmo que também trouxe o decreto de recesso administrativo.

A suspensão das atividades no município começou no dia 19 de novembro e segue até 18 de janeiro de 2027, conforme decreto assinado pela prefeita Francieli Magalhães (PSB). O g1 tenta contato com o município.

Na justificativa apresentada, a administração afirma que enfrenta problemas econômicos e financeiros e precisa reorganizar o funcionamento da estrutura pública. O documento também cita a necessidade de respeitar os limites estabelecidos pela Lei de Responsabilidade Fiscal (LRF) , além de evitar que despesas com a folha de pagamento e outras obrigações fiquem sem cobertura orçamentária.

Durante o período, o atendimento ficará restrito aos serviços considerados essenciais e a alguns departamentos administrativos. Entre as atividades mantidas estão os atendimentos do hospital, os serviços de saneamento e abastecimento de água, a educação, a coleta de lixo e os setores de Licitações e Contratos. O protocolo de Recursos Humanos também continuará funcionando. Já o setor de Tributos terá atendimento em regime de plantão, das 7h às 17h.

Apesar da justificativa de dificuldades financeiras utilizada para determinar a redução das atividades administrativas, a edição do Jornal Oficial dos Municípios publicada nesta segunda também apresentou três contratos para atrações musicais do Festival Gastronômico.

Os valores previstos para as apresentações totalizam R$ 110 mil. A Banda Novo Som e o grupo Os Maninhos receberão R$ 40 mil cada. Já a contratação da Banda Vibe65 foi estabelecida em R$ 30 mil. As três contratações foram realizadas por inexigibilidade de licitação, modalidade utilizada quando há inviabilidade de competição , conforme as hipóteses previstas na legislação.

De acordo com os extratos publicados, as apresentações integram a programação de um festival realizado por meio de convênio com a Secretaria de Estado de Desenvolvimento Econômico de Mato Grosso (Sedec-MT). Os documentos divulgados, no entanto, não detalham qual parcela dos R$ 110 mil será custeada pelo governo estadual e quanto ficará sob responsabilidade da Prefeitura de Santo Antônio de Leverger.

Dessa forma, embora os contratos indiquem os valores dos cachês, não há, nos extratos publicados, detalhamento sobre a divisão dos recursos entre o convênio estadual e a contrapartida financeira do município.

articles.title: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' box office collection day 19: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses Rs 1,704 cr worldwide; earns Rs 12.70 cr on Monday
articles.summary: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, continued its box office run on Monday, November 23, despite witnessing a considerable
articles.body: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, continued its box office run on Monday, November 23, despite witnessing a considerable drop in daily collections.The film earned Rs 12.70 cr in India net collections across all languages, registering a 64.3% decline from the previous day's Rs 35.60 cr. With this, its domestic net earnings have reached Rs 955.45 cr, while the India gross total stands at Rs 1,141.65 cr.Ramayana Movie Review'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' Day 19 language-wise collectionThe Hindi version remained the biggest contributor to Monday's earnings, bringing in Rs 9.25 cr through 13,442 shows. Malayalam followed with Rs 1.50 cr from 826 screenings. The Kannada version collected Rs 85 lakh, while Tamil added Rs 80 lakh. Telugu contributed another Rs 30 lakh. The film recorded an average earning of Rs 8,091 per show across its total screenings.| Language | India net | Shows | Occupancy ||---|---:|---:|---:|| Hindi | Rs 9.25 cr | 13,442 | 14.9% || Malayalam | Rs 1.50 cr | 826 | 38.1% || Kannada | Rs 85 lakh | 438 | 26.4% || Tamil | Rs 80 lakh | 565 | 26.8% || Telugu | Rs 30 lakh | 425 | 18.1% || Total | Rs 12.70 cr | 15,696 | — |Hindi accounted for 72.8% of the day's domestic net earnings. However, Malayalam recorded the highest occupancy among the five versions. The Hindi 3D version registered an overall occupancy of 16.18%. Its morning shows recorded 8.31%, while afternoon and evening screenings registered 17.15% and 23.08%, respectively.The Hindi version has emerged as the biggest contributor to the film's overall domestic business. Its cumulative India net collection stands at Rs 725 cr, accounting for 75.9% of the total. Kannada occupies the second position with Rs 76.15 cr, followed by Telugu at Rs 56.90 cr.The Malayalam version has contributed Rs 49.95 cr so far, while Tamil has added Rs 47.45 cr. articles.body: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', offering a closer look at Steve Rogers' return as Captain America and the massive superhero battle against Doctor Doom.The latest trailer picks up from the newly added scene featuring Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter in the theatrical re-release of 'Avengers: Endgame', which revealed that the couple have a son. However, the revelation has prompted fans to point out that in Marvel Comics, Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff have a son named James Rogers. Taking to social media, some viewers accused Marvel of sidelining Black Widow's legacy in favour of Peggy Carter. One fan wrote, "They stole your son, Natasha Romanoff."Another commented, "James Rogers is the son of Natasha Romanoff and Steve Rogers. LIKE THAT IS LITERALLY HER SON?'‘Avengers: Doomsday’ trailer has fans rooting for Team DoomInterestingly, the latest trailer has also sparked an unexpected reaction, with sections of the audience seemingly siding with Doctor Doom and rallying behind #TeamDoom. articles.title: Music video by Kent singer highlights violence against women
articles.summary: A singer from Kent releases a music video to raise awareness after she was attacked in the street.
articles.body:
"We can never get to a point where we're talking too much about it," says singer-songwriter Daisy Foster about the issue of violence against women and girls.

The 23-year-old from Broadstairs, Kent, has produced a music video for the song she wrote after she was attacked by a man when walking on a street with friends.

The video for SWaN, Safety for Women at Night, will be shown at an event in Ramsgate, bringing together charities, politicians and stakeholders.

The event and release of her music video is set to coincide with the United Nations International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women.

The attack in 2023 left Foster facial injuries requiring hospital treatment.

Releasing the charity single in early 2025, she began work on a music video, working with local students.

It shows a representation of an interview setting where girls have been invited to talk about their experiences.

"We need to have consistent conversations with friends, families, people of different generations, different backgrounds to continue to make progress on this issue," Foster said.

Foster collected testimonies of women's real experiences which feature in the film.

"These women really, you can tell by how they're talking, that they really want to see change and they really want to help others and I think a lot of these women previously felt like there was no one for them to go to," she said.

According to the National Audit Office, more than one in four women are estimated to be victims of sexual assault or attempted assault in their lifetime and one in 12 women are victims of violence against women and girls each year. It suggests the actual number is likely to be much higher.

The premiere in Ramsgate will include a panel discussion including Danielle Georgiou, children and young person's service manager at the Oasis Domestic Abuse Service.

"Violence Against Women and Girls is much higher on the public agenda than it was 10 years ago," said Georgiou.

"Local agencies, schools, charities, all the community organisations are working much more closely together, especially across Kent. But if we listen to victims, survivors and practitioners, we all agree that there is still so much more to do."

Foster hopes to take her work into local schools in the future, to continue the conversation with the next generation.

articles.summary: El youtuber deja bien a la claras lo que sucedió entre bambalinas con el asunto de la fallida entrevista con el líder de VOX
articles.body: Jordi Wild se ha convertido en una de las figuras más comentadas de la campaña electoral del 29N. El creador de contenido logró sentar en 'The Wild Project' a tres de los cuatro grandes candidatos a la Presidencia del Gobierno, aunque hubo una entrevista que nunca llegó a producirse: la de Santiago Abascal. Durante su visita a 'El Hormiguero', donde acudió para presentar su primera novela, el popular 'streamer' y podcaster desveló los motivos que acabaron frustrando un encuentro que, según explicó, estaba prácticamente cerrado. Wild reconoció que su desembarco en el terreno político no ha sido sencillo. Tras semanas marcadas por la presión mediática y el impacto de sus entrevistas, admitió que la experiencia le pasó factura a nivel personal. "Han sido días agotadores psicológicamente", confesó ante Motos. El creador de contenido explicó que decidió aceptar un reto desconocido para él y resumió la experiencia con una frase tan gráfica como sincera: "Me lancé a la piscina y estaba medio llena, pero también me di una buena leche". Pese al desgaste, Jordi Wild aseguró que las conversaciones mantenidas con los distintos candidatos han sido "reconfortantes" y "gratificantes", destacando el aprendizaje que ha supuesto adentrarse en un formato muy diferente al habitual de su canal. Uno de los momentos más llamativos de su entrevista con Motos fue cuando abordó la cancelación de la charla con Santiago Abascal, prevista inicialmente para el mismo formato que el resto de candidatos. Según relató, Vox fue uno de los primeros partidos en aceptar la invitación. De hecho, la formación de Abascal fue la segunda en confirmar su presencia en The Wild Project, lo que llevó al youtuber a dar prácticamente por hecha una conversación que habría completado el cartel de principales aspirantes a La Moncloa. Sin embargo, cuando todo parecía encarrilado, la entrevista terminó suspendiéndose el mismo día en que iba a grabarse, una situación que Wild decidió explicar públicamente durante su paso por El Hormiguero. La situación cambió durante las horas previas al encuentro. Wild ha asegurado que desde Vox le exigieron quedarse con los derechos de emisión de la entrevista, una condición que consideró inaceptable para su programa. La petición sorprendió también a Pablo Motos, que, según recoge Antena 3, coincidió con su invitado en que una exigencia de esas características carecía de sentido. "Esto no es serio", ha explicado Wild al recordar su reacción ante las condiciones planteadas. Finalmente, la entrevista no llegó a realizarse.

articles.title: Calls for Sir Patrick Stewart blue plaque exception
articles.summary: MP says 20-year rule "far too long a time to wait" to honour Mirfield-born Sir Patrick Stewart.
articles.body:
An MP is calling for a blue plaque to honour the life and legacy of Sir Patrick Stewart in his West Yorkshire hometown.

The Mirfield-born star died in October aged 86 after living with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.

MP for Spen Valley, Kim Leadbeater, has asked to make an "exceptional provision" to honour Sir Patrick, despite the National Blue Plaque Scheme's eligibility criteria requiring the person being commemorated to have died at least 20 years ago.

Historic England said although Sir Patrick was not eligible for a plaque "just yet", there would be "many other ways that he will be celebrated and commemorated".

Born in 1940, Sir Patrick's first public performance was in a local church production of Cinderella.

The seven-decade career that followed saw him star as Captain Picard in the Star Trek franchise and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film series.

Despite his Hollywood success, Sir Patrick maintained his Yorkshire roots.

He was a Huddersfield Town fan and a former chancellor at Huddersfield University.

"He kept coming back. He never lost touch with where he was from," Leadbeater said.

"And I think Yorkshire people particularly really like that. I know I do."

According to Historic England, the National Blue Plaque Scheme celebrates people who have made a significant contribution to human welfare or happiness, or have made an exceptional impact in their field, community or wider society.

Sites for a blue plaque must have a strong connection to a historical person who must have been dead for at least 20 years, or to a group which was formed at least 20 years ago and is no longer functioning.

Leadbeater, who has written to the Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport to request the plaque, said 20 years seemed "far too long a time to wait".

"It just seems a real shame that people would miss out, including members of Sir Patrick's family, on having this acknowledgement of what a wonderful human being he was," she said.

"To have something locally that we can go to to remember Sir Patrick, to acknowledge what he did for Mirfield, and how he put it on the map, I think would be really special and really important."

A spokesperson for the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport confirmed it had received the letter but said the scheme was run by Historic England on its behalf.

A spokesperson for Historic England said: "Sir Patrick Stewart made an extraordinary contribution to British cultural life and has a strong connection to Mirfield.

"However, through the National Blue Plaque Scheme we apply the eligibility criteria consistently and we can't make exceptions to the 20-year rule."

articles.title: Jeetendra on Tusshar Kapoor's 50th birthday; says, 'My boy, he never drinks or smokes, and has no late nights'
articles.summary: Veteran actor Jeetendra has opened up about his son Tusshar Kapoor's journey as he celebrates his 50th birthday.
articles.body: Veteran actor Jeetendra has opened up about his son Tusshar Kapoor's journey as he celebrates his 50th birthday. From watching his children grow up to seeing Tusshar become a father, the actor reflected on several personal milestones. He also spoke about the time his film career kept him away from his family, his children's achievements and his own professional journey. In an interview, Jeetendra described Tusshar as an example of responsible parenting and admitted that he still regrets missing important years of his children's childhood.Jeetendra believes Tusshar Kapoor is a better actorDiscussing his son's career, Jeetendra dismissed the idea that professional success alone determines an actor's abilities. He believes Tusshar is more dedicated than he ever was and credited his own breakthrough to an important opportunity early in his career."It is all destiny. Tusshar is a far better and far more dedicated actor than I ever was, and I am not saying this just because he is my son. I was simply lucky to be in the right place at the right time. Think of what would have happened to me if the great V. Shantaramji had not spotted me and made me a hero. I had no experience, no talent, nothing—only luck on my side."Jeetendra calls Tusshar Kapoor an example of perfect parentingLooking back at his children's upbringing, Jeetendra said in an interview with Variety that he finds it difficult to believe that Tusshar and Ektaa Kapoor have reached this stage of their lives. He described both as well-behaved children and highlighted how differently Tusshar approaches his personal life compared to his own younger years."Bachche dekhte dekhte bade ho gaye (the children grew up in no time). Ektaa is 51, and Tusshar is 50. They are lovely children. Neither has ever given me a day of grief. Tusshar is a saint. When I was young, I had a lot of vices. I was a heavy smoker, drinker and had a lot of late nights. I did things that I can’t even mention. But Tusshar, my boy, he never drinks or smokes, and has no late nights. He would rather spend all his non-working hours with his son. Tusshar is an example of the perfect parent, not only for the world, but also for me."Jeetendra particularly admires the attention Tusshar gives his son, Laksshya. He believes his son's decision to prioritise fatherhood is something worth appreciating.The actor regrets being away during his children's childhoodJeetendra also revisited the demands of his acting career and how they affected his family life. His shooting commitments frequently took him to Chennai and Hyderabad, leaving little opportunity to spend time with Ektaa and Tusshar. The actor admitted that watching Tusshar raise his son has made him reflect on those years."When Ektaa and Tusshar were growing up, I was away from home in Mumbai, shooting round-the-clock for South Indian films in Chennai and Hyderabad. I only saw my children when they visited me during their holidays. Today, when I see Tusshar spend so much time with his son, I deeply regret my absence from his life. I can’t express how bad I feel for not spending time with my children. Work is no excuse. It is a guilt and regret I will live with for the rest of my life."He is proud of Ektaa Kapoor's achievementsJeetendra revealed that Tusshar never required much career guidance from him. His concerns were initially greater when it came to Ektaa, whose professional and charitable contributions have made him proud. He also disclosed that Tusshar has now joined him in the construction business."Tusshar is a very sensible and very focused boy. He never needed my advice. It was Ektaa I used to worry about! When she was younger, she did only three things: eat, eat and eat. She would even polish off her brother’s tiffin. I never thought she would be where she is today. Do you know she does charitable work and runs an old-age home without ever talking about it? I am very proud of both my children. I have now involved Tusshar in the construction business that I am running."Jeetendra shares an update on his healthThe veteran actor also spoke about his recovery following back surgery. Although the procedure has affected his routine, he remains keen to continue working and stay professionally active. "I recently underwent back surgery, and that’s taking time to heal. But you know what? I want to die with my shoes on."Jeetendra's recent film credit includes 'Vrusshabha' (2025). articles.summary: Actress Kajol once opened up about the parenting style of her mother, veteran actress Tanuja.
articles.body: Actress Kajol once opened up about the parenting style of her mother, veteran actress Tanuja. Kajol revealed that Tanuja had a very liberal approach to parenting. She never tried to fit her children into society's idea of how individuals should be or what they should become.On the popular chat show 'Jeena Isi Ka Naam Hai,' Kajol described this freedom as the 'biggest gift' her mother gave her as a child. She added that Tanuja's approach to parenting played an important role in shaping the person she is today. Looking back on her childhood days, the 'K3G' actress said, "The great thing about Mom was that she always let us be. We were allowed to be whatever we wanted to be. And there was never any holding us back or trying to mold us or trying to form us into some preconceived notion of what we should be as individuals. We were allowed to grow."Kajol further revealed that her mother never imposed restrictions on them or told them what they should or should not do. She added that such a liberal approach to parenting was uncommon even today. "We were never told that this is not what children do or this is not what you should do. It was just that if it makes you happy, go ahead and do it,' she added. Kajol acknowledged that this kind of parental restraint is far from common. 'I don't think that it's very easy for a parent to let go in that way. And I think that was the most amazing part", she added. During the episode, Kajol also talked about Tanuja as an actress. She admitted that the veteran actress is 'worlds ahead' of her in terms of talent."She is the most spontaneous actress that I know of. I mean, I have worked with her actually, and I feel that if I worked with her today, there would be so much of a difference. articles.title: DR Congo conflict: Army seeks missing aircraft as FRN rebels claim to shoot down plane
articles.summary: A South African fighter pilot and a Ugandan officer are reportedly among those aboard the downed plane.
articles.body:
The Democratic Republic of Congo military says it is searching for one of its aircraft, after rebels said they had shot down a warplane in the east.

The military said it had lost contact with a small Cessna 208 cargo plane on Sunday following "poor weather conditions". The fate of the plane and its crew remained uncertain, it added.

On the same day, the rebel Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN) said it had shot down a warplane that was on a mission to bomb Minembwe in South Kivu province.

Four people were reportedly on board, including a Ugandan and a South African pilot, who is said to have been captured alive.

The BBC has not independently verified the rebels' claim.

It is also unclear whether the aircraft reported missing by the DR Congo military is the same one rebels say they shot down.

Uganda's military on Monday denied any involvement.

What's the fighting in DR Congo all about?

How former President Kabila became FRN rebel leader

A statement attributed to army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba posted on X said: "UPDF had nothing to do with the aircraft that was shot down in Minembwe. We have penalized that company."

The statement did not identify the company or explain what penalty had been imposed.

Gen Kainerugaba later posted that "no Ugandan is allowed to work for mercenary companies in [DR Congo]".

Uganda's denial followed the circulation of a video apparently showing a man being questioned beside the plane's wreckage.

In the footage, the man identifies himself as Ugandan and claims he had been sent by the government. The BBC has not independently verified the video or established the man's identity.

He and the alleged South African pilot are said to be the only other survivors.

South African media outlet Mail & Guardian quoted an FRN spokesperson identifying the pilot as a South African and a "mercenary [who] has no link to the place that he was hired to destroy".

"Unfortunately, we have a multi-country conflict in the eastern DRC," deputy FRN spokesperson Oscar Balinda told the outlet.

In 2022, DR Congo's army blamed M23 rebels, who are now part of the FRN, of shooting down a UN helicopter in which eight people died. The rebels denied it.

The Congolese government has in the past used foreign mercenaries to fight the rebels.

In recent days, fighting between the FRN and the government has intensified with the rebel group accusing the government of targeting heavily populated areas.

The rebels control large areas of eastern DR Congo, including the major city of Goma, after major territorial advances last year.

Aid agencies say the violence is increasingly disrupting healthcare services.

Over the weekend, medical charity Médecins Sans Frontières said fighting in North Kivu had forced some of its teams to temporarily suspend outreach activities.

The fighting has also affected the response to the Ebola outbreak, with many health workers trapped, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

The epicentre of the outbreak is in eastern DR Congo, which has been wracked by conflict for many decades, with some affected areas under rebel control.
